what: A performance workstation for the SMK-37: Telegram is a 101-style synth, Dillo is a 303-style acid synth, the drums are a synthesized 808, and the 16 pads launch Band arrangements.
author: Big Beat Studio

smk37.what: BB-37 for SMK-37 Pro, SMK-37 Elite and MKE-P37. The installer detects the connected model and selects its Build 800 package.
